import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_71/training_0.csv", index_col=0)

# Group by 'Region' and aggregate sum of 'Poblacion' and 'Superficie'
agg_df = df.groupby('Region', as_index=False).agg({
    'Poblacion': 'sum',
    'Superficie': 'sum'
})

# Ensure correct types as per target schema
agg_df['Region'] = agg_df['Region'].astype(str)
agg_df['Poblacion'] = agg_df['Poblacion'].astype(int)
agg_df['Superficie'] = agg_df['Superficie'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target CSV path without the index
agg_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_71/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_71/training_0.csv"

# Strip whitespace from Region column to match target formatting

# Group by Region and aggregate sum of Poblacion and Superficie

    'Poblacion': 'sum',
    'Superficie': 'sum'
})

# Ensure column order and names exactly as target
